releases.title: The Filter Underworks and the Service Drop, plus the Padlock and the PIN Door Lock
releases.summary: The Ashen Conurbation gains a sixth precinct directly under the Filter Ring, the Filter Underworks, and the Service Drop that leads down to it from the plaza grate: the shaft, the east service tunnel, the Sump Hall with its condensate pool, the pipe leeches that drop from the pressure mains, the service cage, the service key, the sump gauge and the condensate bucket. Alongside it the building mod gains a Padlock and a PIN Door Lock. They hang on every door in the pack, the 21 vanilla doors included, and a locked door cannot be broken by players, mobs, bosses, TNT, pistons or commands. A padlock opens, closes and breaks only for the person who hung it and for operators; a PIN door lock only for those who have entered its 4–8 digit number.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Filter Underworks (sixth precinct): an underground layer directly beneath the Filter Ring, y40–63 within 96 blocks of the centre. Contamination continues there — no filter grace. Below y64 the survey map shows an inner circle and a centre mark

The Service Drop: from the sump grate in the middle of the plaza at (0,64,0) a shaft goes down to y49, with a ladder and a redstone-powered service cage (sneak-use inside it to ride between y49 and y65, ten ticks apart; unpowered it says the cage has no charge). For testers, /fallout drop lands you inside the cage

The east service tunnel: three blocks wide at y50–52 from x=4 to the first viaduct pier at x=132, with a pressure main on the ceiling every four blocks and a service locker at x=64 (one service key guaranteed plus 3–5 items). The ladder at its end climbs to the viaduct deck (y72)

The Sump Hall (a sump-brick box, x −10..10, y48–59, z −10..10): a 5×5 condensate pool, four condenser coils, two kinetic seizure machines and three chests (5–8 items). Standing there grants "Take the Drop"

Pressure mains and pipe leeches: one main in five is infested; walk under one within four blocks above eye level and a leech drops from the ceiling (health 10, attack 2, speed 0.24, climbs walls). A bite gives 4 s of residue sickness and 2 s of slowness. It drops 0–1 condensate vial and a service key one time in five. Underworks spawn table: pipe leech 80 (2–5), scrap sentinel 5 (1), nothing else

Condensate (a fluid) and the condensate bucket: contact gives 6 s each of Sump Damp (slowness I + mining fatigue I) and residue sickness. It cannot be placed in or flow into the Residue Flats or the Vein Pit — only the ring and the underworks — and molten residue can no longer be placed in the underworks either. Right-click a condensate source with a condensate vial to refill it to 8 uses (the source stays). Filling a bucket in the underworks grants "Prime the Sump"

Service Key (2 iron ingots + 1 iron nugget, no durability): the only thing that opens and closes the sump grate — hands and redstone do nothing to it. Sump Gauge (6 iron ingots + sump grate + condensate vial): held in the main hand it shows on the action bar how many pressure mains are within 16 blocks and how many of them are charged by a kinetic seizure machine. Sump Brick ×4 = 3 precast concrete + 1 condensate vial
Sump mist drifts through the underworks, and three sounds arrive with it (cage, grate, leech drop). The Assembly Colossus does not wake for players inside the Sump Hall, the shaft or the tunnel

Padlock (5 iron ingots): right-click a door you placed yourself. Only you and operators (permission level 2 or above) can open, close, dig or break it; for everyone else the door stays shut and no cracks appear. Sneak + empty hand as the owner takes it off and drops the padlock

PIN Door Lock (6 iron ingots + stone button + redstone dust): right-click opens a keypad; choose 4–8 digits and confirm with #. Only people who have entered the number can open, close or break the door. A wrong number starts a lockout on that lock (1 second, doubling up to 10 minutes, for everyone); the right number lights the green lamp for two seconds and opens the door

A locked door does not break: mining, TNT and warhead explosions, the wither, pistons, removing the floor under it, even /setblock over it — the door stays and nothing drops. Redstone does not open it and zombies stop pounding on it. When an allowed person breaks it, one door and one lock drop

Every door counts: the 12 wooden, the iron and the 8 copper vanilla doors, and the building mod's 2 armoured and 10 kit doors. The lock hangs on the face where you clicked and swings with the leaf; on the hatch it sits on the plate

Only the person who placed the door (and operators) can lock it, so nobody can seal someone else's house. Doors placed before this version, and the city's doors, can be locked by operators only. An open door cannot be locked

sections.title: Balance changes
items: No Ashen Conurbation number changed (the sickness clock, the mask's durability, the colossus's health). The underworks are contaminated exactly like the Collapsed Precincts, with no grace
Only the building mod and the Ashen Conurbation mod changed. The other eleven mods are untouched inside (only their version numbers move to 4.2.3)

sections.title: Warnings
items: The Ashen Conurbation mod's pickaxe tags (mineable/pickaxe and needs_diamond_tool) had been written in the wrong place since V4.2.0, so vanilla pickaxes never read them. V4.2.3 fixes this: blocks that require a tool now drop correctly with a pickaxe, and the Filter Ring's wall needs a diamond pickaxe (a behaviour change)
The underworks appear in existing Ashen Conurbation worlds only in chunks that have not been generated yet. A centre that is already generated will show neither the shaft nor the hall
The fog colour when submerged in condensate (#A0E6E2) is not implemented — 26.2 has no per-fluid fog hook — so the biome's fog applies
A door can be locked only by the person who placed it (or an operator). Doors placed before V4.2.3 carry no placer record: ask an operator if you want one locked
A locked copper door stops weathering (honeycomb and axes do nothing) until the lock comes off
For administrators: /doorlock admin remove <x y z> (permission level 3) removes a lock without breaking the door; every use is logged and announced to the operators present
The lock items are in the "building" creative tab. Trapdoors and fence gates cannot be locked

releases.title: The Condenser Reach and the Ashen Viaduct, plus a clean sweep of the doors
releases.summary: The Ashen Conurbation gains the Condenser Reach to the east and the Ashen Viaduct that runs there from the Filter Ring's east gate: the Bleed Shed at its end, four waystations along the way, the Coil Crawler, the Viaduct Token and the Condensate Vial. Alongside it the building mod's doors are replaced wholesale: every door of V4.2.0 and earlier (102 of them) is removed and ten new doors built from the design renders take their place. The V4.2.1 Wheel Vault Door and Riveted Hatch can no longer be destroyed by any boss, mob, TNT or warhead; a player digs through in three minutes.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Ten new doors, each reproduced from one design render, all animated: the Studded Steel Double Gate (4×3), the Hangar Blast Gate (6×4, slides sideways into its pocket), the Keypad Security Door (2×3, the lever drops first), the X-Braced Vault Door (3×4, two turns of the wheel), the Iron-Bound Double Door (3×5, the bar slides free first), the Gear-Driven Gate (3×4, brass gears lift a stone slab), Blast Door 01 (5×4, lifts into the lintel), the Round Airlock Door (3×3, four clamps turn free first), the Portcullis (3×4, winches turn) and the Cell Door (2×3, the latch slides first). Right-click or redstone for all of them

The Wheel Vault Door and the Riveted Hatch are indestructible: no boss, mob, wither, dragon, raid, heavy sniper, TNT or nuclear warhead can break them. Only a player can, with a pickaxe, axe, shovel or hoe, in exactly three minutes whatever the tool's tier (bare hands and swords make no progress)

The Ashen Viaduct: from the ring's east gate (x=128) to the Condenser Reach (x=480), a five-wide deck runs unbroken at y=72 with a rail on the centre line, filter lamps every 16 blocks along both edges and a pier every 12 blocks, cutting a corridor through towers and rubble. While you stand on the deck no new Residue Sickness sets in (an existing one keeps ticking down). Wind every 80 ticks

Four waystations (north side at x=192, 256, 320, 384): bleached-precast booths with a collapsed window, a chest (iron nuggets, condensate vials, a viaduct token, crystals, coal, bread) and a condenser coil on the roof. Two in five carry a Coil Crawler marker that spawns one crawler, once, when you come within 32 blocks

The Bleed Shed (x=496 to 516, 21×13×21): its west face opens onto the viaduct; inside, six condenser coils, two chests (vials, tokens, stabilised residue, a filter mask, a survey map), a Kinetic Seizure in an iron-bar bay and a 3×3 cistern under the floor. Forty ticks inside grant Wet Coil for 8 seconds (Haste I, and Residue Sickness drains twice as fast); the ceiling drips

The Coil Crawler (14 health, 3 damage, 0.28 speed): neutral to anyone on the deck, hostile to anyone who steps down onto the Reach, a pier or a coil. It climbs walls and coils and drops 0-2 condensate vials and 0-1 residue crystal. Reach spawns: crawlers 70 (packs of 2-4), stalkers 15, no pulse hounds

The Viaduct Token (right-click on the deck for 30 seconds of Speed I with a 30-second cooldown; elsewhere it says the token only wakes on the viaduct) and the Condensate Vial (8 uses: residue and residue veins become bleached precast, buds vanish, a molten residue source vanishes, contaminated asphalt becomes viaduct deck; the ring wall and the seizure are untouched). Recipes: token = 4 iron nuggets + 4 vials + stabilised residue; vial ×2 = glass bottle + water bucket + condenser coil; bleached precast ×4 = 2 precast + 2 vials; viaduct deck ×4 = 4 bleached; stonecutter: bleached → pier

The Survey Map's scale widens to 512 so the Reach, the viaduct line and the terminus fit on the sheet (the diamond is unchanged). Two advancements (Follow the Heat Line, Still Condensing). /fallout viaduct takes testers to the east gate deck

sections.title: Balance changes
items: The V4.2.1 numbers, the colossus's health and the mask's durability are unchanged. On the Reach the sickness clock is the Collapsed Precincts' (10 s bare, 40 s masked), but it stops on the deck
Only the building mod and the city mod changed; nothing inside the other eleven mods moved (the version number alone goes to 4.2.2)

sections.title: Warnings
items: ⚠ The 102 doors of V4.2.0 and earlier (the automatic doors, fusuma, large doors, hatch, camouflage door, roller shutter, sliding glass door, jail bars and the 93 generated doors) are removed. Old doors placed in an existing world disappear (they become air) when it loads with this build, and old door items vanish from inventories. This is a wholesale replacement at the owner's instruction
The automatic door's power settings (autoDoorRequiresPower and three more) are gone from the config. The other powered devices (security camera, elevator, escalator, ATM) are unchanged
Condenser coils drop only with a pickaxe or silk touch; other tools drop nothing
In an existing city world the viaduct appears in chunks that have not been generated yet, not in chunks already generated
Everything from V4.2.3 onward (the Underworks and so on) is not in this build

releases.title: Finishing the Ashen Conurbation, plus the Wheel Vault Door and Riveted Hatch
releases.summary: A small update that gives the systems V4.2 laid down their look and feel. The city's sky becomes a perpetual dusk with no stars and no moon, and the fog thickens district by district. Residue buds grow, the Kinetic Seizure's shaft turns, and the Survey Map draws the city on your screen. Three bugs are fixed and three numbers tuned. Alongside it, the building mod gains the Wheel Vault Door (3×3) and the Riveted Hatch (2×2) built from the design renders, both animated: the vault door turns its hand-wheel and draws its bolts before the leaf swings.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Wheel Vault Door (3×3) and the Riveted Hatch (2×2, floor or ceiling): armoured doors reproduced piece by piece from the 3D design renders. Right-click the vault door and its hand-wheel turns one and a half times, six bolts withdraw, and only then does the leaf swing open 90 degrees (three seconds). The hatch lifts its handle and then opens 100 degrees. Both work with redstone, and their collision disappears while open, so nothing gets crushed. Recipes: 4 stone bricks + 4 iron blocks around 1 netherite scrap for the vault door; 4 iron nuggets + 4 iron ingots around 1 iron block for the hatch

The Ashen Conurbation has a sky of its own. The sun hangs just above the western horizon and never moves; there is no moon and there are no stars. The zenith is purple-black, the horizon brown, the clouds dark, and the sun a weak brown-purple disc. Fog differs by precinct: the Filter Ring sees far, the Vein Pit is thickest

Residue crystal grows. On any air face touching budding residue, buds advance small → medium → large (never in water), at a twenty-fifth of amethyst's pace and never inside the Filter Ring. A large bud does not turn into a block of residue by itself. Each step makes a small sound and a puff of purple motes

The Kinetic Seizure really runs. Its shaft turns at 16 RPM without stopping, purple motes leak from it, and within 12 blocks a low grinding loop plays. Every five seconds there is an 8% chance that the nearest player within six blocks catches four seconds of Residue Sickness (creative and spectator players excepted). Its tooltip now reads 'Unstable. Do not stand close.' and '16 RPM · 256 SU', and it glows faintly

Use the Survey Map and a map of the city appears in the middle of the screen for ten seconds: the diamond, the Filter Ring, the Vein Pit, the Condenser Reach to the east, and, inside the city, an arrow for where you stand and which way you face. Sneak to close it. Used outside the city it says the survey plate is inert here

In 4.2.0 not a single particle was drawn (the falling-debris warning, the condenser coil's drips, the filter lamp's sparks): the client-side registration was missing. All three are visible from 4.2.1, and blue-green sparks now drift around filter lamps

The Ashen Gateway answers a right-click at last: on the gateway it takes you to the city's centre, and inside the city it brings you back where you were. It can also be crafted now: 4 precast concrete + 4 residue crystals + 1 ender pearl

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Time before Residue Sickness sets in bare-faced: 8 seconds → 10 seconds (the 40 seconds with a filter mask is unchanged; the mask's 240 durability has been in place since 4.2.0)
Minimum interval between falling debris: 60 seconds → 80 seconds (the 120-second maximum is unchanged)
Range at which a Pulse Hound's howl is triggered: 24 blocks → 20 blocks

sections.title: Warnings
items: Fixed: after entering through the Ashen Gateway, a relog no longer loses the way home (the return point is stored on the player, not the server, and survives death)
Fixed: molten residue can no longer flow into the Filter Ring; residue that tries to is removed (the same area the bucket already refuses)
Fixed: the Assembly Colossus's slain record is stored in the city dimension itself. A record 4.2.0 left in the overworld is inherited once, so a world where it was killed will not get a second one
The city's terrain, precincts and enemies are unchanged, and nothing inside the other eleven mods changed (only the version number moves to 4.2.1)
Everything from V4.2.2 onward - the viaduct, the Condenser Reach, the Underworks - is not in this build

releases.title: The Ashen Conurbation — one whole contaminated megacity
releases.summary: A new dimension: an industrial megacity that collapsed in a kinetic catastrophe. The purple-black crystal called Residue has eaten the streets, the steel and the living alike, and only the Filter Ring at its heart is safe. It arrives as a thirteenth mod, so it touches neither your existing world nor any other mod.

sections.title: Highlights
items: A new dimension, the Ashen Conurbation: a diamond-shaped ruin 384 blocks from centre to vertex, in permanent dusk under a purple-brown sky. /fallout enter takes you in and /fallout leave brings you back (operator permission required)

Five precincts: the Filter Ring of radius 128 (the only safe ground), the Collapsed Precincts outside it (towers up to 28 floors, a 30% chance of a loot chest per floor), the Residue Flats beyond the diamond, the Vein Pit below (radius 48, under y 56), and the Condenser Reach to the east

Residue Sickness: stand outside the ring and it sets in after 8 seconds bare, 40 seconds with a filter mask. Hunger, and half a heart every three seconds. Inside the ring it drains four times faster and cannot be caught at all

The filter mask (240 durability, losing 1 per second in contaminated air) and the stabiliser canister (16 uses, four seconds of Grace within four blocks). Molten residue is a real fluid you can carry in a bucket, but the Filter Ring will not take it

Three enemies and one boss: the Residue Stalker (24 health), the Pulse Hound (18, howling every 200 ticks to strengthen its pack), the Scrap Sentinel (40, which lets you pass if you are masked and inside the ring), and the Assembly Colossus at the bottom of the pit (320, with three phases keyed to its health)

Residue crystals, stabilised residue, a survey map and 25 blocks - precast concrete, rebar frames, collapsed windows, vent grates, filter lamps, the kinetic seizure and more. A furnace turns crystals into stabilised residue
Falling debris happens only on the Residue Flats, and a purple mote warns you 40 ticks before impact, so it can be dodged

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Not one byte of the other twelve mods changed in this update - the shipped jars were compared against the source to be sure. Only the version number moves to 4.2.0

sections.title: Warnings
items: The Ashen Conurbation is a new dimension. Adding it to an existing world changes nothing about that world's terrain
Outside the Filter Ring, simply standing still costs you health. Do not linger without a mask or a canister
There is one Assembly Colossus per world. Kill it and it never returns
Everything from V4.2.1 onward - the viaduct, the Condenser Reach, the Underworks - is not in this build. What the Upcoming page lists is not yet in your game

releases.title: Chemically strengthened glass, sapphire, Apex Gear and a mains water grid
releases.summary: Sixty-eight kinds of glass that survive a siege, an ore rarer than netherite, armour that outguards the old masks eightfold, and a water grid for a whole town. It installs straight into an existing world, and the config files gain the new keys on first start. The masks' old numbers (50 defence, 814 durability) are corrected automatically.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Chemically strengthened glass: 4 families x 17 colours = 68 blocks (plain, tinted, lantern, tinted lantern). A diamond pickaxe or better is required, and only Silk Touch brings the block back
Siege endurance: a storm boss needs about eight minutes of continuous assault per block. A vanilla wither takes ten times longer, and one stick of TNT barely scratches it. Lanterns hold half as long
Sapphire: deepslate ore, raw, gem and block. One attempt in twelve chunks, a single block a vein, Y -64 to -48, and never where a face would be exposed. Fortune adds 0 or 1, capped at two raw
Apex Gear, four pieces: 100 defence each, 400 for the set. Smithed from a netherite piece with a sapphire. Two pieces take 10% off explosions, the full set 25% and two extra hearts

A municipal water grid, nine blocks: intake, wellhead, pump station, reservoir, water tower, treatment filter, consumer port, meter and aqueduct slab. Pressure starts at 32, falls by 1 a pipe, and a pump restores 32 up to a cap of 64
The ore washer and the steam boiler only reach full speed on a live consumer port; a bucket line runs them at half speed
The Sparxie and Sparkle masks are four times stronger (200 defence, 3256 durability). The downvote stick was resized only - its reach is unchanged

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Masks: defence 50 -> 200, durability 814 -> 3256. A config file still holding the old numbers is corrected on start
A pressurised run longer than 64 pipes without a pump bursts: it places exactly one water source, then stays dead until an industrial wrench repairs it

sections.title: Warnings
items: Chemically strengthened glass drops nothing to bare hands or an iron pickaxe. That is the opposite of reinforced glass, which always drops itself, so check how you plan to recover it before you build with it

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The siege-boss tag ships empty: this pack contains no Wither Storm, so add your own with a datapack. A vanilla wither is already counted automatically, at a tenth of the rate
Sapphire being rarer than ancient debris is shown by comparing the generation settings, not by a ten-thousand-chunk survey
The reservoir is a single block (32,000 mB). A multiblock tank waits for the dynamic tank in a later update

releases.title: The industrialisation update: 29 new elements to crush ore, make steel and run a factory
releases.summary: A full industrial chain arrives in the power mod. Start with a hand crank and a water wheel, raise steam for electricity, make steel in a coke oven and a blast furnace, crush and wash ore into plates and rods, and automate it all with belts and an assembler arm. It installs straight into an existing world; the config files gain the new keys automatically on first start.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Rotation (01, 02, 09): hand crank, power axle, water wheel, electric motor. An axle only carries rotation along its own axis, so pulling one out cuts the drive. The water wheel goes beside flowing water, never in a still pool, and three in a row make the middle one stronger.

Steam (03, 04): boiler and turbine. The boiler burns solid fuel and turns bucketed water into steam; run it dry and the heat climbs until it trips for ten seconds. The turbine turns steam into electricity and feeds the breaker through a cable.

Metallurgy (05, 06): coke oven and blast furnace. Both are 3x3x4 structures built from firebrick with the controller as their front. Coal becomes coke; iron, coke and calcite become **steel** - this pack's first metal, and the start of every plate, rod, wire and gear that follows.

Fluids (10, 11, 22, 23): pressure pipes and a valve, electric pump, distillery, refinery generator. A pipe remembers the first fluid through it and refuses any other until it empties. The valve shuts on redstone. The pump moves fluid between vessels and never creates water.

Processing (14-17, 24, 29): crusher, ore washer, arc furnace, rolling mill, lathe and recycler. Ore becomes crushed ore, then dust with 250 mB of water, then an ingot, a plate, rods and wire, and finally screws and gears - one unbroken chain, with twelve new intermediate materials.

Logistics (12, 13, 18, 19): item conveyor and ramp, sorter gate, assembler arm, blueprint card. These belts carry **items only** - the decoration mod's belt is a moving floor for people, and stays as it is. The card copies the Automated Fabricator's 3x3 template and hands it to the arm.

Factory (25-28, 30): industrial smoker, safety siren, scaffold and catwalk, wrench, controller hub. The siren sounds and emits redstone while any machine within 16 blocks is at heat 90 or more. The wrench turns machines, and dismantles them cleanly when you sneak.
Every machine now carries heat from 0 to 100 and stops for ten seconds when it reaches the top. Nothing explodes. The crusher and the arc furnace are the ones that get hot.

Cables, transformers and batteries are **not** rebuilt. The four cable tiers already here (conductor size and insulation, 100 V / 200 V / 6.6 kV), the transformer with its iron loss, and the battery that mints energy cells all serve the new machines as they are.
Power figures map onto the existing grid at 1 IU/t = 20 W, so an ordinary machine draws the 800 W this pack has always used as its reference.

sections.title: Balance changes
items: A conveyor belt draws 2.5 W, so eight of them are exactly one machine's worth of electricity.
The Geofracture Drill still needs no power. Everything new here does, apart from the smoker, siren, scaffold, catwalk and sorter.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Installs straight into an existing world. The V4.1 keys are written into the config files automatically on start.
Steam, creosote, refined fuel and residue **cannot be placed in the world**. They exist only inside this pack's tanks and pipes, and no bucket will hold them.
The distillery does not throw its residue away. When the residue tank fills, the machine jams until you pipe it out.
The controller hub and the siren watch **machines with block entities**. Belts and pipes are not counted.
The machines have no screens. Feed them with hoppers or adjacent containers, and right-click with an empty hand to hear what they are doing.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The specification's Dynamic Tank is not in this release; detecting an arbitrary cuboid is a larger job and is held over.
The specification's grey concrete powder does not exist in this version of Minecraft, so the recycler yields andesite instead.
There is no Minecraft client in the development environment, so the new machines' looks, sounds and particles have not been checked in-game.
