releases.title: Verified Nuclear-Warhead Power Generation, Major Rail Update, New Screen Design, Always-On Coordinates
releases.summary: Updated 5 mods at once (there are no v1.9.1 or v1.9.2 releases — the major rail update and the nuclear-warhead power generation requests are bundled together and shipped as v1.9.3). We've finally delivered Spark Doll α's art, which had actually been fixed two releases ago but had never once made it into a shipped build, along with a fix for batteries breaking when left fully charged for a long time, a new (not-yet-run) way to verify on a real server that nuclear warheads can be used as fuel, and a fix for the Rocket Launcher's scope bug. Rail gained a major update including automatic departure and automatic driving, Power/Guns/Boss screens got the new "Glimpse Glass" design, and always-on coordinate and TPS/ping displays were added.

sections.title: Highlights
items: [Important] The Spark Doll α art bug (part of the right ear appearing to vanish) had actually already been fixed after v1.9.0.2, but a flaw in the mechanism that compares build outputs meant it never once made it into a distributed build. The fixed art finally arrives with this release. To make sure this never happens again, we've introduced a new check (check_dist_drift.py) that directly diffs source assets against the distributed build.

[Important] Power: Fixed a bug where a fully charged Battery, left alone for about 18.6 hours, would stop producing Energy Cells forever. The cause was an addition overflow, which showed up faster with higher-output fuels (like nuclear warheads). Batteries already broken by this bug will fix themselves automatically once you install this release.

Power: The mechanism for using nuclear warheads as fuel has existed since v1.8.7, but this round we set up a way to verify it on a real dedicated server for the first time (however, the test environment was lost during this packaging round, so it hasn't actually been run yet -- see the warning below for details). Also fixed a bug where the fuel-grade display showed the raw, untranslated string "sorakaze_power.fuel_quality.nuclear."

Guns: The Rocket Launcher's scope is finally visible on screen (fixed after being reported twice). Its zoom level has also been raised from ×2 to ×4. The appearance of both sniper rifles is unchanged.

Major Rail update: added automatic departure, automatic driving, running sound, overhead catenary wires (decorative only), interior cabin lights and headlights, arrival announcement displays, the ability to walk around inside the train, and the ability to sit in seats. The speedometer moved to the top of the screen and is no longer shown to passengers — only the driver sees it.

Adopted a new translucent design, "Glimpse Glass," for Power/Guns/Boss screens (Battery, Breaker Panel, Missile Launcher, Enhanced Beacon, and more). Also added background blur for when you open your inventory or a chest. A new optional resource pack, Glimpse_Alpha_Glass_UI_Pack.zip, is now bundled as well, which extends the glass look to vanilla screens too.

Coordinates (including facing direction) are now always shown on screen. The TPS/ping display was also redesigned, and the default changed from "only while holding Tab" to "always shown" (you can restore the old behavior via config).

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Rocket Launcher scope zoom: ×2 → ×4

sections.title: Warnings
items: Within the major Rail update, adding higher-tier train cars and coupling with vanilla minecarts were both deferred this time (only a design document was produced). Coupling with vanilla minecarts touches on this project's policy of "never replacing or removing vanilla elements," so it will be decided separately after further discussion.

Proof of the dedicated-server verification for using nuclear warheads as fuel could not actually be carried out this time, since the test environment was lost during the packaging process (the mechanism itself for using nuclear warheads as fuel is unchanged since v1.8.7).
If you still haven't deleted the Backrooms world folder as described in the v1.9.0.2 change, please make sure to take care of that as well.
No config deletion or editing needed. Everything added this time is a brand-new setting.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: Nearly all of the new Rail features (automatic departure, automatic driving, running sound, catenary wires, cabin lights, arrival announcements, walking around inside the train) were still unconfirmed on real hardware at this point.
The look of the new "Glimpse Glass" screen design and the look of the new resource pack were both also unconfirmed.
The actual on-screen look of the always-on coordinate and TPS/ping displays was also unconfirmed.
3 automated tests in Guns and 1 in Power remain flaky, with results varying from run to run. All of them have been confirmed to concern existing code that wasn't changed in this release.

releases.title: Completely Redesigned the Phone/Computer "Mine OS" Screens, Fixed Icon Bug
releases.summary: This update touches only the building & decor mod. Completely remade the look of the phone/computer "Mine OS" screens and added 3 new apps: Settings, Terminal, and Music. Also fixed the app icon bug that had persisted since v1.8.6. Additionally, we've corrected the Video app's first-time download size and discovered it doesn't work on macOS.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Completely redesigned the phone/computer screens, adding frosted-glass-style translucent panels, rounded corners, and shadows. Computers now have 3 traffic-light buttons in the top-left, a "Mine OS ▸ App Name" breadcrumb up top, and a Dock at the bottom; phones gained a status bar, home indicator, and lock screen. The Messages app now shows chat-style speech bubbles with the other person's head icon.

Added 3 new apps (8 → 11 total): Settings (device/server info and a sound toggle), Terminal (help, about, ping, tps, and cls respond instantly; anything else is sent as a chat command), and Music (plays songs from music discs available on this server).

Fixed a bug, present since v1.8.6, where app icons were hidden behind a gray panel. The cause was vanilla's opaque button background getting drawn over the same spot right after the icon was rendered (the artwork itself had been correct from the start).

Fixed text overflowing or getting cut off on screen, and added a new automated check to keep it from happening again (measured 4,773 locations across 2 languages × 23 screen sizes, confirming zero overflows).

sections.title: Warnings
items: ⚠ The Video app does not work on macOS Minecraft (confirmed by testing; Windows and Linux remain supported). Starting with this release, macOS no longer silently freezes — it now shows "Not available on this OS" and stops.
[Correction] The Video app's first-time download is not "roughly 140–175MB" — measured, it's about 300MB (correcting the inaccurate figure given as of v1.9.0.1).
No config deletion or editing needed (just 4 new settings added, all defaulting to "shown").

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: Mine OS's new look, the feel of using the 3 new apps (Settings, Terminal, Music), and whether the Music app actually plays sound were all still unconfirmed on an actual screen at this point.
Whether the icon bug was actually resolved hadn't been visually confirmed — the fix was based only on analysis of the draw order.
Whether the Video app actually displays web pages on real Windows/Linux machines remained unconfirmed.

releases.title: Fixed Backrooms Maze Not Generating (World Action Required)
releases.summary: v1.9.0.1 fixed the rifts themselves, but we discovered — and fixed — a bug where the Backrooms dimension beyond them stayed completely empty (the void). If your world has ever had a player visit Backrooms, you'll need to delete the dimension folder. Also fixed the appearance bug affecting 3 items, and Survival's Spark Doll α has been replaced with artwork drawn by the owner themselves.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Backrooms: Fixed a bug where passing through a rift led nowhere — there was no maze anywhere, and even in Creative you'd die instantly. The cause was tripping both of two filters in Minecraft's "superflat" world-generation system, so the maze had never actually been built in any chunk. Also placed bedrock beneath the floor and added a rescue procedure in case you do fall through.

Backrooms: Fixed a bug where the Drop of Calm, Flashlight, and Torn Note all showed up in your inventory as the "purple-and-black checkerboard" missing-texture pattern. The definition file that determines their art was missing entirely.
Survival: Replaced Spark Doll α's art with pixel art drawn by the owner themselves. No functional changes (mechanics, recipe, drops, or config).

sections.title: Warnings
items: [Important] If your world has ever had a player visit Backrooms, stop the server and delete the <world name>/dimensions/sorakaze_backrooms/backrooms/ folder. The next time someone passes through a rift, it will be rebuilt as a proper new maze. Backrooms is a dimension where you can't place or break blocks, so deleting it costs you nothing (items like the Drop of Calm, Flashlight, and Torn Note in your inventory won't disappear). If you can't find the folder, no one has entered that world yet, so there's nothing you need to do.
No config deletion or editing needed (just 2 new settings added, which take effect automatically).

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: How the fixed maze actually looks (the mood of the yellow wallpaper, etc.), the art for the 3 fixed items, and how Spark Doll α's new art looks were all still unconfirmed on an actual screen at this point.

releases.title: Fixed End City Rifts and Wither Storm Flight, Added a Video App
releases.summary: Fixed a bug where the Backrooms rifts added in v1.9.0 were effectively never generating, and a bug where the Wither Storm's airborne-stage flight had never actually been implemented. The building & decor mod gained a "Video" app for phones and computers, along with device-specific OS-style screens, and Survival's Spark Doll α now has its finalized appearance.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Backrooms: Fixed a bug where End City rifts were, in measured practice, essentially never generating. The check was looking at the height (Y coordinate), but the coordinate it actually received always had a height of 0, so it was always misjudged as "absent." On newly generated land, every End City is now guaranteed exactly one rift (this doesn't retroactively apply to existing land). Also redrew the icon art for the Drop of Calm, Flashlight, and Torn Note.

Wither Storm: Implemented genuine 3D flight for the airborne stages (S3–S5) — circling in, diving to attack, then peeling away. The grounded stages (S0–S2), melee attack, head barrage, tractor beam, and Great Vortex damage formulas are unchanged.

Building & decor: Added a "Video" app to phones and computers (it embeds an actual browser engine; the first time a player opens it, a one-time extra download runs on their PC). Screens now vary by device model — iPhone gets an iOS-style look, while MacBook and Mac Studio get a Macintosh-style look (menu bar, Dock).
Survival: Finalized Spark Doll α's appearance (a visual-only change; functionality is unchanged).

sections.title: Warnings
items: This release listed the Video app's first-time download size as "roughly 140–175MB," but that was the compressed size and was incorrect (corrected to a measured ~300MB in v1.9.0.3).
No config deletion or editing needed. This update only adds new settings.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: At this point, the Backrooms rifts themselves were fixed, but a separate bug remained where the maze beyond them wasn't generating at all (discovered and fixed in v1.9.0.2).
Whether the Video app actually displays web pages, and how the new iPhone/macOS-style screen designs look, were both still unconfirmed.
Whether the Wither Storm's airborne-stage flight actually looks natural in motion (the feel of the circling and diving) was also unconfirmed.

releases.title: New Mod "Backrooms" Joins the Pack, Wither Storm Overhauled
releases.summary: The 9th mod, "Backrooms," has joined the pack — a sanity-driven exploration experience reached through rifts that spawn near End Cities. The boss mod's Wither Storm has been completely overhauled with a new look, growth stages, and a new status effect, plus new guaranteed drops. The other 6 mods (building & decor, guns, power, sky, rail, vehicles) are unchanged.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The 9th mod, "Backrooms" (sorakaze_backrooms), has joined the pack. Every time an End City generates, exactly one rift (an altar) spawns nearby in a safe spot — one per City (existing End Cities don't get one).

Features a sanity system. It maxes out at 100 and drains to zero in about 18 minutes if you do nothing. Drinking the restorative item found in chests recovers 35. Roughly every 30 seconds there's a 12% chance of a "blackout," and things start to change once sanity drops below 20.
You can't place blocks inside the maze, and the walls, floor, and ceiling — including the chests — can't be destroyed at all. Other dimensions are unaffected.
The entity "Hollow Listener" roams the maze (40 HP, 6 attack damage. It freezes while you're looking at it and moves again once you look away). Up to 3 can be present at once.
A 3-stage progress tracker (① confirm you're alive → ② gather traces → ③ escape) stays on screen at all times.

Completely remade the Wither Storm boss's appearance. Replaced the old fixed-HP, single-stage design with a growth-stage system (S0 Embryo → S1 Gorging → S2 Hunting → S3 Rampage → S4 Tempest → S5 Zenith, HP ranging 600–24,000). It advances stages based on how many items and mobs it has absorbed, and from S2 onward it floats and generates a gravity field that pulls things toward it.

Added a new status effect, "Wither Sickness." It sets in after repeated exposure to the tractor beam or gravity field (the default is half of vanilla Wither's damage-per-second; drinking milk cures it like any other status effect).
Added an admin command, /glimpse storm restore [radius], which restores terrain the Wither Storm has devoured by writing it back from a log.

Added 2 new guaranteed drops for the Wither Storm: "Omnigatherer α" (32 durability, same as a golden pickaxe, and not enchantable — a separate item from the existing plain "Omnigatherer") and "Firework Doll α" (unlimited uses, but with a 3-minute cooldown between uses — an upgraded version of the existing Firework Doll).
Discontinued bundling the recipe reference sheet (レシピ早見表.html) with releases. Crafting reference has moved to this site.

sections.title: Warnings
items: We did not implement the name "Almond Water" that the owner had requested, since it's judged to be a proper name tied specifically to the sanity-restoring item within Backrooms creative communities. The function (restores sanity, found in chests, single-use) is unchanged — only the name was reworked, to "Drop of Calm."
If you right-click a chest while holding a block item, the block-placement restriction triggers first and the chest won't open. Empty your hand or switch to a different item before opening it.
No config deletion or edits are needed. This update only adds new settings — none of the existing settings' defaults have changed.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The overall look of Backrooms (the maze wallpaper and lighting mood, the entity's appearance and freeze effect, the blackout effect, the progress-tracker HUD display, and the contents of chests) has not yet been confirmed in actual gameplay.
The Wither Storm's new appearance, how its form changes at each growth stage, the gravity field's visual effect, and the look of it devouring terrain are also unconfirmed.
The visual/audio effect of contracting Wither Sickness, and the appearance (icon and in-hand model) of Omnigatherer α and Firework Doll α, are also unconfirmed.
Backrooms's dedicated boot-proof task (runBackroomsBoot) hasn't yet been run as a standalone check on a dedicated server (the 9-mod simultaneous boot test did confirm the dimension loads).
Sync between two simultaneous players, and server load with all 9 mods running at once, are untested.
The attack animations for the Sculk Golem, Rock Lock, Kraken, and Titan, and the ability to throw the Lightning Spear, are once again carried over to a future update.

groups.summary: Nuclear Warhead Buffed Again, Battery Added to the Power Mod

releases.title: Nuclear Warhead Buffed Again, Battery Added to the Power Mod
releases.summary: Buffed the Nuclear Warhead's direct-hit damage another 3x, and its impact sound now carries much farther. The Power mod also gained a new block, the Battery, changing how generator power gets delivered.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Nuclear Warhead direct-hit damage increased 22,400 → 67,200 (3x).
The impact sound now carries out to a 20,000-block radius. The launch sound is also much louder now.
The Missile Launcher was made larger, and a staged, spreading destruction effect plus a flash were added for Nuclear Warhead impacts.

Added a new block, the Battery, to the Power mod. Power from generators and nuclear plants is now first stored in a Battery, which produces Energy Cells once it's charged up. You take the resulting Energy Cells and plug them into a Breaker Panel's fuel slot to use them.

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Nuclear Warhead direct-hit damage: 22,400 → 67,200 (3x)

sections.title: Warnings
items: [Important] Generators and nuclear plants can no longer deliver power to a Breaker Panel without going through a Battery. Wiring them the old way — "generator → cable → breaker panel" — by itself no longer delivers electricity. Solar Panels, Wind Turbines, and Water Flow Generators still deliver power directly, as before.
No config deletion needed.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: 2 of the Nuclear Warhead-related tests couldn't be fully confirmed when run under heavy load in the dev environment (the warhead's detonation and destruction themselves have been confirmed working via live detonation tests on a real server).
The look of the Battery's lid open/close animation hasn't been confirmed.

releases.title: Rocket Launcher & Nuclear Warhead Buffed, Gun Sound Effects Overhauled
releases.summary: Raised the Rocket Launcher's power 8x and significantly widened the Nuclear Warhead's blast radius. Also gave the scope and lock-on — which were already working correctly but easy to miss — new sound effects that make them much easier to notice. The Nuclear Warhead can now also be used as the Power mod's new top-tier fuel.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Rocket Launcher damage increased 40 → 320 (8x).
Nuclear Warhead direct-hit damage buffed to 320 × 70 = 22,400. Its blast radius was also significantly widened, but it's designed to be safe — it won't destroy bedrock or unloaded terrain.

Created new sound effects for while you're aiming down the scope and for the instant a lock-on completes. Previously these used vanilla's generic UI sound, so even though the features themselves worked fine, they were easy to miss.
The Nuclear Warhead can now be used as fuel for the Power mod — an energy source with roughly 100x the output and 144x the burn time (about 1 hour) of a vanilla bucket of lava.

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Rocket Launcher power: 40 → 320 (8x)
Nuclear Warhead direct-hit damage: 22,400 (320 × 70)

sections.title: Warnings
items: No config deletion needed. The defaults update automatically.

The Missile Launcher itself still has no way to protect against its own explosion. Its minimum range (24 blocks) is smaller than the Nuclear Warhead's blast radius (64 blocks), so aiming at a nearby target can destroy the launcher along with it.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The look of the nuclear explosion (particles, screen shake) and the new sound effects haven't been confirmed in actual play yet.
FPS and lag during a large-scale nuclear explosion with players present haven't been verified.

releases.title: Added Missile Warhead & Phone App Icons
releases.summary: Two fixes related to appearance and discoverability. Resolved the missile and nuclear warheads having zero textures by drawing dedicated icons from scratch and making them craftable. Also added the Missile Launcher, which players reported being unable to find, to the creative tab, and filled in the translations for its display name and control panel. The phone/computer's 7 apps also got dedicated new icons.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Drew dedicated 128px icons for the missile and nuclear warheads from scratch (previously there was no art at all — they showed up in your inventory as Minecraft's standard "purple-and-black checkerboard" missing-texture pattern).
Made the missile warhead (5 Iron Ingots + 1 TNT + 1 Redstone Block) and nuclear warhead (4 Blocks of Iron + 4 TNT + 1 Nether Star) craftable for the first time.

Added the Missile Launcher to the creative tab (crafting it was already possible before, but it never appeared in the tab, so it couldn't be found). Also added the display name and translations for its control panel screen — target coordinate entry, 9 status displays, 8 compass directions, the safety switch, and more (54 strings each in Japanese and English).

Drew dedicated new icons for all 7 phone/computer apps (camera feed, messages, lookup, weather, calculator, phone, camera) — previously it was just a row of colored squares. Also added per-app flourishes, like a precipitation icon and enlarged clock in the weather app, a recessed LCD-style design in the calculator app, a compass-needle display in the phone app, and a surveillance-monitor look for the camera feed app.
Improved it so opening an app now always shows that app's icon and name at the top of the screen.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Making the missile and nuclear warheads craftable was a decision made by the dev team (not an explicit request from the owner). If the balance feels too strong or excessive, please talk to the admins.
No config deletion or editing needed this time either.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The "Lookup" app's 3×3 recipe screen can't receive grid-placement data for ingredients from the server, so it falls back to a simplified display that packs ingredients in order from the top-left (the ingredient types and quantities themselves are correct).
The warheads' new icons, the control panel's translations, and the phone app's new screens are all still unconfirmed on the actual in-game screen.
16 of the 17 Reinforced Glass Pane colors still don't have names set, a carryover issue from earlier versions.

releases.title: Fixed Water Pipe, Enhanced Beacon & Gas Mask Bugs
releases.summary: Fixed several bugs reported after v1.8.4: water pipes being unbreakable, the Enhanced Beacon Alpha/Beta not letting you pick abilities, and the gas mask appearing to float above the head. Also fixed the hostile mob spawn cap to correctly apply to the Overworld only, and changed the default to a flat 150 mobs.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Fixed water pipes being unbreakable. A unit mix-up meant the hitbox was only 1/32nd the visual thickness (hardness and tool requirements themselves were correct from the start).
Also fixed water pipe intakes standing alone in a river getting swept away and disappearing (redesigned as a waterlogging-capable block).

Fixed the Enhanced Beacon Alpha/Beta not letting you pick abilities. The screen would auto-close the very next tick after opening, and selections weren't being saved either (the standard Enhanced Beacon was unaffected).
Fixed the gas mask appearing to float above the head. Created a new dedicated 3D model and repositioned it to fit the face.

Reverted the Firework Doll's appearance from the 3D "plush toy" look added in v1.8.4 back to the flat art style it had through v1.8.3 (per the owner's request). No changes to functionality like the use-count limit.

Changed the Overworld hostile mob spawn cap from the previous "15x vanilla" (roughly 1,050 mobs) to a flat 150 mobs. Doesn't affect the Nether, the End, or the Sky (also fixed the earlier bug where this mistakenly applied to every dimension).

sections.title: Warnings
items: No config deletion or editing needed. The spawn cap value updates to the new default automatically.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The new appearance of the water pipe and gas mask, and how the Enhanced Beacon GUI feels to use, haven't been confirmed in actual play yet.
Whether the new spawn density of 150 mobs feels right in actual play hasn't been verified yet.

releases.title: New Weapons, Phone OS, Water Pipes, Seasons & Sky Expansion
releases.summary: Added a big batch of features at once: 2 new weapons (Handgun and Submachine Gun), a Missile Launcher with 2 warhead types, real OS functionality for phones and computers, water pipes, an elevator that actually moves, and a spring/summer/fall/winter season system. Also raised the Overworld's build height ceiling (no change underground), and drastically reduced the list of sorting blocks and hoppers that required electricity.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Added 2 new weapons: the Handgun (200/sec, 12-round magazine, semi-auto) and Submachine Gun (450/sec, 40-round magazine, full-auto). Both use the existing small-caliber rounds, so no new ammo type was added.

Added the Missile Launcher (a placed weapon) along with Missile Warheads and Nuclear Warheads (the nuclear warhead has a cap on how many blocks it can destroy; both are Missile-Launcher-only and can't be fired while held).
Added a 2x zoom sight and lock-on feature to the Rocket Launcher (locks on after aiming for 1 second continuously; won't lock onto a target that's running).

Added real OS functionality to phones and computers (7 apps: camera feed, messages, lookup, weather, calculator, phone, and camera). Launch it by holding it and right-clicking, or pressing H — you can even take a photo and send it via message.
Added water pipes (supply water from a river or ocean to a cauldron or farmland). Also added an elevator whose car actually moves up and down.
Added Heavy-gauge Cable (reaches 4x the distance of regular cable), Shielded Cable (8x), and the LED Panel to the Power mod.
Completely reworked ore textures. Added the new material "Lavender Jade" (even rarer than Ruby), the Gas Mask, and the Aero Shield.
Added a season system (8 days per season, 32 days per year). Deserts in summer and snowy plains in winter are now harsher than before.
The Enhanced Beacon's Alpha and Beta tiers (Boss mod) are now craftable. Also, the base Enhanced Beacon no longer needs electricity (reverting the requirement added back in v1.8.1).
Raised the Overworld's build height ceiling from y=319 to y=1023 (no change to underground or the bottom of the world).

Drastically shrank the list of devices requiring electricity from 17 down to 3 (Void Trash block, laser emitter, auto turret). Hoppers, the 8 auto-sorting blocks, the conveyor belt, both traffic light types, and the automatic train stop block now all work without electricity.

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Assault Rifle: measured 4,500 → 5,850 damage/sec
Minigun: measured 250 → 50 damage/sec (a heavy nerf — now weaker than a diamond sword)
Sniper Rifle and Heavy Sniper Rifle damage also increased. The durability calculation factor for sniper-class weapons also changed 0.5 → 0.6

sections.title: Warnings
items: Rockets fired from the Missile Launcher keep destroying terrain even with mobGriefing set to false. To stop only the terrain destruction, set rocketDestroysTerrain to false in the config.
The Overworld's build height was extended to y=1023. This affects everyone, even if you never use the Sky dimension (no change underground).

Since the list of sorting blocks and hoppers requiring power was drastically shrunk, devices that had previously been stopped will automatically start working again. Watch out for unexpected reactivation in areas you haven't touched in a while.
The gun damage changes above are applied automatically. No config deletion or editing is needed, but you can revert them individually by specifying values in the config.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: Immediately after release, the Enhanced Beacon Alpha/Beta had a bug preventing ability selection (fixed in the next update).
Immediately after release, the Missile Launcher didn't show up in the creative tab and had no display name set. Icons for both warhead types were also missing (resolved in the next update).
The phone/computer apps didn't have dedicated icon art yet — just a row of colored squares (improved in the next update).

releases.title: Appliances Go Electric, and Machines Generate Heat
releases.summary: 5 Building Materials devices — the security camera, elevator, escalator, automatic door, and ATM — now require electricity. Also, running machines like generators and nuclear plants now heat up the surrounding room, and without ventilation or cooling, you can start taking heat damage.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The security camera, elevator, escalator, automatic door, and ATM now require electricity (already-placed ones are affected starting from the next server start too). The elevator still works "going down" even without power, to prevent getting trapped.

Running machines like generators and nuclear plants now heat up their surroundings. Leave 8 machines running uncooled and the room temperature climbs to roughly 77.8°C, with damage starting after about 14 seconds.
Fixed the air conditioner to actually consume power properly (previously it was treated as consuming none).

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Machine heat: leaving 8 uncooled machines running raises room temperature to roughly 77.8°C, with heat damage starting after about 14 seconds

sections.title: Warnings
items: You'll need to wire cables to the security camera, elevator, escalator, automatic door, and ATM. Already-placed equipment will also stop working as of the next server start.
Areas around heat-generating machines like generators become dangerously hot without ventilation or air-conditioner cooling.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: How the 5 newly electrified devices (security camera, elevator, escalator, automatic door, ATM) actually behave — with or without power — is unconfirmed.
The appearance and usability of the 3 new generator types and their fuel slots are unconfirmed.

releases.title: Bigger Air Conditioner & Simplified Power Device Placement
releases.summary: Significantly enlarged the air conditioner, giving it real presence in a room. Also streamlined the Power mod's devices so each one is complete just by placing a single item, and fixed a bug where the fireplace had zero effect in snowy biomes.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Enlarged the air conditioner (now roughly 3.1×2.0×2.1 blocks). It's built from an outdoor unit with a round fan, coil fins, and a glowing control panel, plus an indoor unit with 3 louvers jutting outward — making it one of the largest devices in the Power mod.
Unified Power mod devices so you no longer need to assemble multiple blocks — placing a single item now completes the whole thing.
Fixed a bug where the fireplace had zero effect in snowy biomes. Terrain cold and equipment warmth are now calculated separately.

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Snowy plains, standing next to your own lit fireplace: felt temperature -24.0°C (frostbite damage) → +2.4°C (safe)
Roofed base, nighttime, snowing, with a fireplace: -18.6°C → +7.9°C

sections.title: Warnings
items: If you're standing outside in a blizzard at night, a single fireplace can still sometimes not be enough (combine it with a roof, armor, or an additional fireplace).

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: Whether the temperature balance feels right in actual play hasn't been verified yet.
The new 3D appearance of the 9 auto-sorting blocks is unconfirmed.

releases.title: Power Mod Added — Redstone Now Needs Electricity
releases.summary: The 8th mod, "Power," joins the pack. In one of this project's biggest changes yet, vanilla redstone circuitry — redstone dust, repeaters, comparators, redstone blocks, and redstone torches — now needs electricity from a generator to function. Every existing redstone contraption, from auto-farms to stations to automatic doors, will shut down until you wire up a power grid.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The 8th mod, "Power," joins the pack. You can now build out a power grid with generators, nuclear plants, breaker panels, cables, and more.

17 components — levers, buttons, pressure plates, tripwire hooks, observers, daylight sensors, sculk sensors, targets, trapped chests, detector rails, lecterns, jukeboxes, lightning rods, and more — still work without electricity, as before (manually opening/closing doors and gates works as usual too).

A redstone block will naturally break about 10 minutes after being placed, returning to your inventory as an item (this prevents a "free power source" that needs no electricity from just sitting around).

3 special exceptions — the Void Trash block, laser emitter, and auto turret — are designed the opposite way: without power, they stay "active" as a safety measure (so you don't accidentally lose important items or mobs).
Fixed the Sniper Rifle, Heavy Sniper Rifle, and Laser Gun's projectile speed to the intended value (no change to damage, fire rate, magazine size, durability, or range).

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Sniper Rifle / Heavy Sniper Rifle projectile speed: 16.0 → 24.0 (1.5x)
Laser Gun projectile speed: 16.0 → 48.0 (3x)

sections.title: Warnings
items: Every existing setup that uses redstone circuitry — auto-farms, stations, automatic doors, and so on — will shut down. You'll need to wire up a power grid (generators and cables) from scratch.
To fully revert this change, set powerEnabled to false in config/sorakaze_power.json. To revert redstone specifically while keeping the rest, set redstoneRequiresPower to false in the same file.
Observers and daylight sensors are intentionally left needing no electricity, so you retain an in-game way to recover a base that's lost power.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: How it actually feels to play in a world where redstone stops working, and how thoroughly farms and stations end up shut down, are unverified.
The cables lighting up, the breaker panel's screen, and the appearance of the generator and nuclear plant haven't been confirmed on real hardware yet.
After switching power off and back on, an isolated cable not connected to a breaker panel can sometimes stay lit (breaking and replacing it fixes it).

releases.title: Config Auto-Repair (v1.8.0 Reissue)
releases.summary: A fixed version reissued the same day. In the original v1.8.0, old values left over in earlier versions' config files were overwriting the new defaults, so things like the security camera's resolution, Excalibur's stats, and the Rocket Launcher's terrain destruction weren't taking effect. Going forward, you no longer need to manually delete config files with every update — a new mechanism automatically updates only "stale values set by an earlier version" to the current defaults on startup.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Introduced a mechanism that automatically detects "fossil" values left over from an earlier version and rewrites them to the current defaults. You no longer need to manually delete config files for future updates.
It never touches values you've tuned yourself — a value only gets updated if it matches a past version's default exactly.

With this fix, the security camera's resolution (768 → 3840), Excalibur's stats (attack power 12 → 75, attack speed 1.8 → 0.6), the Rocket Launcher's terrain destruction, and more now correctly take effect in actual play.
5 mods were updated this time: Boss, Building Materials, Guns, Sky, and Survival. Rail and Vehicles are unchanged this time.

sections.title: Warnings
items: This reissue ships under the same version number and filenames as the original v1.8.0. If you have the original v1.8.0, discard it and replace it with this version.
From now on, the "please delete your config files" step we used to mention with every update is no longer necessary.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: Excalibur's new stats and the Rocket Launcher's terrain destruction effect haven't been confirmed in actual play yet.

releases.title: Renamed to "Glimpse Alpha"
releases.summary: The mod group's name changed from "Sorakaze" to "Glimpse Alpha." Only display-facing names changed — jar filenames, creative tab names, distribution zip names, and so on. Internal block/item IDs, world data, and config filenames are all completely unchanged. Everything you've already built and every item you're carrying carries over exactly as-is. This release also tuned gun and boss-drop weapon stats, and raised the security camera's resolution.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Renamed from "Sorakaze" to "Glimpse Alpha" (display name, jar filenames, creative tab names, distribution zip name — all of it).
Internal IDs, registry IDs, config filenames, and save data are all completely unchanged. Every existing build, item, and bit of progress carries over exactly as-is.
The distributed resource pack was also renamed to "Glimpse_Alpha_Mask_Skin_Pack.zip" (from the old Sorakaze_Mask_Skin_Pack.zip).
Raised the security camera's default video resolution from 768 to 3840.
The Rocket Launcher's explosion now destroys terrain (previously it destroyed nothing).

Shotgun damage: 15 → 17.25
Sniper Rifle damage: 20 → 23
Heavy Sniper Rifle damage: 80 → 92
Sniper-class weapon durability: 128 → 64

Excalibur (boss-drop greatsword): attack power 31 → 75, attack speed -3.1 → -3.4, durability 6,093 → 3,047

releases.title: All 7 Mods Updated Together, Guns Return to Real Bullets
releases.summary: All 7 mods updated to v1.7.7 at the same time. Guns switched from hitscan (instant hit) back to actual traveling-projectile bullets (damage values themselves are unchanged). A new weapon, the "Rocket Launcher," a train automatic stop block, the Firework Doll, and many other new features were added across the mods.

sections.title: Highlights
items: [Guns] Bullets went back to actually traveling through the air. The visual feel changes, but each gun's damage value itself is unchanged.
[Guns] Added the new weapon "Rocket Launcher" and its dedicated ammo. It deals direct-hit plus explosion damage, and terrain destruction is off by default.
[Building Materials] Doors now close even with someone standing in the doorway. They're designed to have no hitbox while closing, so you won't take damage from being caught in one.

[Building Materials] Added colored Reinforced Glass Panes (17 colors), 5 decorative blocks (smartphone-, laptop-, and desktop-shaped), and a vault door. Also expanded the security camera's max video resolution (the default is unchanged).
[Boss] The number of special effects you can pick simultaneously on the Enhanced Beacon went from 3 to 5.
[Boss] "Excalibur," the drop from defeating Rock Lock, was rebuilt as a greatsword. It now has a dedicated 3D model, and its stats were buffed too.
[Sky] Fixed a bug where a ridden Dragon's body faced the opposite direction from its actual travel direction.
[Sky] Buffed Angel's Staff. The Royal Sword and the full set of Angel Gear also got reworked into more three-dimensional models (no stat changes).
[Rail] Added the new Automatic Train Stop block. Place it under a rail, and it will smoothly and automatically stop any approaching train.
[Vehicles] Fixed a bug where part of the vehicle body would stay invisible after using the first-person cockpit view once. Also reworked the appearance of 11 vehicle types.
[Survival] Roughly doubled the generation rate of Pearl Ore and Ruby Ore (newly generated land only). Added Block of Pearl and Block of Ruby.

[Survival] Added the new item "Firework Doll." Like a Totem of Undying, it's a charm that prevents death once, but it's more powerful and can be used up to 3 times. It can also be placed as decoration.

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Excalibur (boss drop): damage 12.0 → 36.0 (3x), attack speed halved, reach 3.0 → 4.0 blocks, and it now applies knockback. However, its drop rate changed 100% → 70%.
Angel's Staff: damage 12 → 20, range 48m → 64m, shortened cooldown, melee bonus 7.0 → 10.0 (this is the first time it's surpassed Angel's Sword's melee bonus).
Rocket Launcher: 40.0 direct-hit damage plus explosion damage (explosion power equivalent to a creeper). Magazine size 1, and it has the slowest projectile speed of any gun.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Config deletion needed: `sorakaze_boss.json` (Excalibur's stats), `sorakaze_sky.json` (Angel's Staff's stats). Without deleting them, the new numbers won't take effect.

We also recommend deleting `sorakaze_guns.json`. Without deleting it, there's a bug where the newly added "projectile speed" setting stays stuck at an abnormally slow value for every gun (this doesn't affect damage or other power-related numbers).

Of the 5 new decorative blocks, the smartphone-, laptop-, and desktop-shaped ones are modeled after real-world products, but both the in-game display and the install guide describe them only by their shape — no brand names are used.

[Balance] Even at this point, the Assault Rifle is still extremely strong at roughly 3,750 damage/sec — even with the Enhanced Beacon, Excalibur, and Angel's Staff all buffed, most bosses can still be killed in a few seconds. No resistance has been added to either guns or bosses.
Note: version numbers 1.4.3, 1.6.x, 1.7.2, and 1.7.6 were internal numbers used during development and were never actually distributed.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: How it feels for doors to now close even with someone standing there, how the Rocket Launcher's firing and impact feels, and how usable the Enhanced Beacon's new GUI is, are all unconfirmed on real hardware.
How Excalibur and Angel's Staff's new 3D models actually look, and how the Dragon's direction fix actually looks, are also unconfirmed.
The appearance of the Firework Doll, Pearl/Ruby blocks, and the Automatic Train Stop block, plus the PC performance impact of the security camera's higher resolution setting, are also unverified.
The Kraken and Titan's attack animations are still not implemented as originally specced (pending confirmation from the owner).
The 2 Sky mod issues found in v1.7.3 (raid lag, tamed dragons disappearing) are a separate matter from this update's Sky mod changes, and remain unresolved.

releases.title: Fixed Reinforced Glass & Double-Door Bugs
releases.summary: This is a Building-Materials-mod-only update. Fixed a bug where Reinforced Glass (all 17 colors) took a flat 75 seconds to mine regardless of tool, and a bug where the 50 large center-opening double doors added in v1.5.0 didn't visually swing all the way open.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Reinforced Glass can now be mined with a hoe. Mining speed now varies with the tool's tier (wood through netherite) and Efficiency enchantment. It previously had a bug that made it take a flat 75 seconds regardless of tool.
Reinforced Glass can no longer be destroyed by the Wither or Ender Dragon.

The 50 large center-opening double doors (3×3 and 3×4 sizes) now visually swing open properly. They previously had a bug where they only slid open the same small amount as a regular door, so the doorway never looked fully open.

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Rough mining times for Reinforced Glass: wooden hoe ~37.5s, stone hoe ~18.8s, iron hoe ~12.5s, golden hoe ~6.25s, diamond hoe ~9.4s, netherite hoe ~8.4s (~2.25s with a diamond hoe and Efficiency V). Bare hands, pickaxes, axes, shovels, and swords still take 75 seconds.

sections.title: Warnings
items: [Design limitation] The original goal was "only a dedicated axe can mine this faster," but due to how vanilla's systems work, it ended up so that any hoe — including a wooden one — mines it faster (scaled to its tier). We couldn't restrict it to one specific tool.
No config deletion needed. This fix doesn't use any config values.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: How it actually feels to mine Reinforced Glass with a hoe, and whether the double doors visually look properly open on screen, haven't been confirmed on real hardware yet.
The Kraken and Titan's attack animations are still not implemented as originally specced.
The 2 Sky mod issues found in v1.7.3 (raid lag, tamed dragons disappearing) remain unresolved, since the Sky mod wasn't touched this time.

releases.title: Restricted the Plague Doctor's Spawning to Summoning Stones Only
releases.summary: This is a Boss-mod-only update. Removed the mechanic where the Plague Doctor could randomly spawn during bad weather — it can now only be summoned with a dedicated summoning stone, just like the other 10 bosses.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Changed how the Plague Doctor boss spawns. The old "randomly spawns during bad weather" mechanic is gone, unified into placing a new "Plague Doctor Summoning Stone" to summon it — the same 3×3 layout as the other 10 bosses, with Wither Rose in the corners, Phantom Membrane on the edges, and a Nether Star in the center.

sections.title: Warnings
items: If you were waiting for bad weather to find the Plague Doctor, it will no longer appear that way going forward. Craft a summoning stone and summon it instead.
No config deletion needed. The removed settings were only related to natural spawning and don't affect the values that remain.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The summoning stone's activation effect, the Plague Doctor's own appearance and dedicated voice, and the sacrifice effect are unchanged this time and remain unconfirmed on real hardware.
The Building Materials mod is not part of this update. Fixes for reinforced glass and doors are in progress separately, and will be reflected in a future update.
The 2 Sky mod issues found in v1.7.3 (raid lag, tamed dragons disappearing) remain out of scope this time.
The Kraken and Titan's attack animations are still not implemented as originally specced.

releases.title: Fixed the Train's Windows & Singapore Bugs
releases.summary: Fixed a bug where you couldn't properly see outside from the train's driver seat or passenger seats, and fixed bugs in the sky-bound city-state of "Singapore" where buildings wouldn't generate or ruins would remain floating in midair. Also fixed the hostile mob spawn cap to apply only to the Overworld, and adjusted the enchantment level cap to a sane value.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Fixed a bug where sitting in any of the train's 8 car types (driver seat or passenger seats) mostly showed the wall below the window instead of the outside. You can now properly see forward and to the sides.

Fixed bugs in the sky-bound city-state of "Singapore" where buildings wouldn't generate at all, the same hotel would keep getting built over and over, and trees or villages would remain floating in midair. However, this only fixes newly generated land after the update. For terrain that's already generated and broken, we've included a recovery tool for admins that regenerates just the affected areas.
Added config options to the Boss mod for adjusting the Plague Doctor's spawning.
Halved the Wyvern's breath attack damage.
Fixed a bug where the natural hostile mob spawn cap was mistakenly also applying to the Nether and the End — it's now Overworld-only (Survival mod).

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Minigun damage reduced 75%.
Assault Rifle damage increased 25%. Measured per-second damage output now ranks Assault Rifle 3,750 > Laser Gun 2,000 > Minigun 250.

The Universal Harvester (the boss-drop mining tool) changed from a durability system to a use-count system — it breaks after 5 uses. It can no longer be given Mending or Unbreaking at an anvil, but Efficiency, Fortune, and Silk Touch can still be applied.
Adjusted the default enchantment level cap from 255 → 20 (the configurable maximum also shrunk from 255 → 32). This eliminates the bizarre "enchantment level 255"-style numbers some players reported.

sections.title: Warnings
items: 3 configs need to be deleted: `sorakaze_guns.json`, `sorakaze_sky.json`, and `sorakaze_survival.json`. Without deleting them, this update's numeric changes won't take effect. `sorakaze_boss.json` does not need to be deleted.

[Important] Running a large-scale, long-duration integration test of the Sky mod turned up 2 new problems. Neither is fixed yet: (1) large raid events may cause lag/frame drops, and (2) a tamed Ender Dragon can sometimes disappear over time (tamed Wyverns are not affected).

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The raid lag and tamed-dragon-disappearing issues above remain unresolved.
The Plague Doctor's appearance and spawning, and how it feels for the Universal Harvester to break after 5 uses, haven't been confirmed on real hardware yet.
The Kraken and Titan's attack animations are still not implemented as originally specced (pending confirmation from the owner).
The Singapore recovery tool has only been verified against test data — it hasn't yet been verified against actual world data.

releases.title: Emergency Fix for a Crash-on-Launch After Installing v1.7.0
releases.summary: Installing v1.7.0 caused the game to crash every single time it launched. The cause was in how the Vehicles mod registered its keybinds (landing gear, flaps, doors, and so on), and updating just the Vehicles mod to v1.7.1 resolves it.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Only the Vehicles mod (sorakaze_vehicles) was updated. The other 6 mods stay at v1.7.0 and are fine as-is.
No new items or blocks this time — this is purely a launch-crash fix.

sections.title: Warnings
items: If you installed v1.7.0 and the game "crashes every time on launch," be sure to replace the Vehicles mod's jar file with this v1.7.1 version.
The other 6 mods (Guns, Rail, Building Materials, Boss, Sky, Survival) work fine staying at v1.7.0 — there's no need to replace them.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: How the new features added in v1.7.0 — like the vehicle first-person (cockpit) view — actually look and feel is still unconfirmed by anyone, since the crash prevented anyone from checking.
Two-player sync and server load with all mods running simultaneously remain unverified.

releases.title: All 7 Mods Updated Together, Hidden Content Unlocked
releases.summary: All 7 mods fell into step for the first time, now shipping under the same version number (v1.7.0). Fixing a bug in the recipe reference sheet also brought a lot of previously hidden content to light — things like the grocery items and facility items from the sky-bound city-state of "Singapore" that hadn't been showing up before. sections.title: Highlights

Fixing a bug in the recipe reference sheet means it now shows the 300 grocery items purchasable in the sky-bound city-state of "Singapore," along with items like the siege ram, property deed, real estate ledger, and grocery shelf. These are all store-bought items and can't be crafted.

Removed the bank (ATM) deposit balance cap (previously 100,000) — you can now deposit without limit.
Added a recipe to turn a Block of Amethyst back into Amethyst Shards.
Enabled a change significantly raising the enchantment level cap (normally 30) (Survival mod).

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Laser Gun: damage 160 → 200, fire rate 6 → 10 rounds/sec, magazine size 100 → 200 rounds.
Drill: mining speed 12.0 → 24.0, durability 2,048 → 10,240.
Significantly raised the population caps of the Sky Kingdom and Angel City (e.g. the Kingdom's merchants 16 → 48, citizens 64 → 192).
Security camera default video resolution changed 192 → 768.

sections.title: Warnings
items: For the Guns mod (sorakaze_guns) and Sky mod (sorakaze_sky), you must delete `config/sorakaze_guns.json` and `config/sorakaze_sky.json` after updating or the numeric changes above won't take effect.

For the Building Materials mod (sorakaze_deco), don't delete its config — just edit the `cameraFeedResolution` value. Deleting it would reset every other setting, like traffic light timings, back to default too.

Guns' measured damage output is now extremely high — roughly 3,000/sec for the Assault Rifle, 2,000/sec for the Laser Gun, and 1,000/sec for the Minigun — meaning most bosses can be killed within seconds.

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The newly introduced raid boss "Armored Invader" may not look very "armored" yet — expect further tuning in the future.

Train cars are still scaled at roughly 1/3 of a real train's size. Also, the hitbox width increased from 1.8 → 2.0 blocks, so existing 2-block-wide tunnels may no longer fit it. The original 3 car types (train, passenger car, freight car) still have no windows, interior, or doors.

Added an egg incubator to the Sky mod. Hatched Wyverns/Dragons will tame to you, and you can ride them with a dedicated saddle

sections.title: Balance changes
items: [Correction] We previously described the Assault Rifle as dealing roughly 2,000 damage/sec against a single target, but actual measurement shows it's really about 400 damage/sec (earlier notes had significantly overestimated its damage output)

sections.title: Warnings
items: The new "Minigun" has an effective damage output of roughly 4,000/sec, making it the strongest weapon in this project. It can kill most existing bosses within a few seconds, so if you want to preserve some challenge, lower `minigun.damage` in the config
You don't need to delete any config files for this update (new settings are automatically appended on startup)
Pearl Ore and Ruby Ore don't appear in land generated before the mod was installed. If you can't find any, explore newly generated land

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The security camera's panning animation isn't implemented yet — it currently has a fixed viewpoint
The Sculk Golem, Rock Lock, Grim Reaper, Kraken, and Titan still don't have dedicated attack animations, and their signature-move telegraphs are particles and markers only
The Thunder Spear still doesn't support throwing — melee attacks only

groups.label: V1.4
groups.summary: Sky City Densified, New Mob "Wyvern" Arrives

releases.title: Sky City Densified, New Mob "Wyvern" Arrives
releases.summary: Reworked Sky City's scale into a denser, more high-rise metropolis. 4 towering 300-block-tall spires now serve as new landmarks at its center. Also added a new flying enemy, the "Crystal Wyvern."

sections.title: Highlights
items: Shrank Sky City's footprint and rebuilt it as a denser city (heights now vary by district)
Just the 4 spires at the city center now reach 300 blocks tall
Added streetscape details like ground-floor entrances, awnings, rooftop equipment, and separated roads and sidewalks
Placed 16 loot chests around the city across 3 types: rooftop, office, and warehouse
New mob "Crystal Wyvern" debuts. It flies and attacks with a fireball breath (targets players only — it won't attack city residents)
Adjusted Sky Castle's spawn interval (the previously recommended settings had a bug that made castles essentially never appear)

sections.title: Warnings
items: Against the Assault Rifle's damage output, the Crystal Wyvern (200 HP) dies in an instant. If you want more of a challenge, adjust the gun damage settings
The city size reduction only applies to newly generated land. Existing Sky Cities keep their old size, so you may see an odd size mismatch where they're adjacent to newer ones

releases.title: Sky City World Generation Reworked, Fixed Citizen Overpopulation Bug
releases.summary: Reworked how Sky City and Sky Castle generate internally to make it more stable, and fixed a bug where Sky City's population would keep creeping past the cap with every server restart.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Fixed a bug where Sky City's population would keep growing past the cap across repeated server restarts
Internally streamlined how Sky City and Sky Castle generate (generation load actually went down)
Adjusted the spacing between Sky Cities and Sky Castles

sections.title: Warnings
items: The generation changes only apply to newly generated land. Existing Sky Cities and Sky Castles keep their current appearance

releases.title: Sky City Reworked into a Futuristic City, New Boss Arrives
releases.summary: The Sky mod's "Sky City" got a complete overhaul into a futuristic high-rise metropolis, and a new "Sky Castle" plus new boss "Sky Archangel" made their debut. Also added: a new mob, "Angel Citizen," walking the streets, and changes to how you pay for gear.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Reworked Sky City into a futuristic high-rise city (added 20 skyscrapers, a road network, pedestrian bridges, and a central plaza)
The new "Angel Citizen" mob, with 4 different looks, now wanders the streets
"Sky Castle" debuts (castle walls, 8 round towers, a great hall, a central keep, an underground treasury, and 6 loot chests)
The new boss "Sky Archangel" now appears in Sky Castle — one per castle, and it won't respawn once defeated
Added the boss's guaranteed drop, "Angel's Staff" (1.5x damage and half cooldown while airborne)
Reworked the Sky portal's appearance into a gold-and-Glowstone frame, and added a lighting-up animation
Buying Sky gear now costs a mix of Emeralds and Diamonds

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Sky portal natural spawn rate lowered from 1/340 → 1/1200 (they're now considerably harder to find)

sections.title: Warnings
items: Portals are now much harder to find. If you can't find one in an existing world, admins can lower the spawn rate via config, or enable `allowPlayerBuiltSkyPortals` to let players build portals manually

The Assault Rifle's damage output is extremely strong (roughly 2,000 damage/sec), so this boss (2,000 HP) can be killed in about a second. If you want more of a challenge, adjust the gun damage settings

releases.title: Fixed the Sky Dimension Crash
releases.summary: Fixed a serious bug where the client would always crash on entering the Sky dimension (caused by the game having zero renderers registered for drawing Angels and Angel Golems). Also buffed the Heavy Sniper Rifle's damage and added a new scope zoom level.

sections.title: Highlights
items: [Important] Fixed a bug that always crashed the client on entering the Sky dimension (caused by Angel/Angel Golem rendering never being registered). The same bug also occurred with Angels left over in old worlds from before the Sky relocation
Changed the Heavy Sniper Rifle's damage to 4x the regular Sniper Rifle's (40.0 → 80.0)
Added a new "×12" scope zoom level (Heavy Sniper Rifle only)
Changed it so mouse-wheel input is ignored while looking through a scope (prevents accidentally switching hotbar slots)

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Heavy Sniper Rifle: damage 40.0 → 80.0 (4x the regular Sniper Rifle)

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: Whether this fix actually resolves the Sky dimension crash hasn't been confirmed by actual play yet. Please check whether entering the Sky dimension no longer crashes, and report it if it still does

releases.title: Major Gun Damage Buff & 40 New Doors
releases.summary: Massively buffed the Laser Gun and Assault Rifle's damage — 20x and 10x respectively. This damage boost significantly throws off the combat balance against existing bosses. Also fixed a bug where the auto turret had actually never fired a single shot, guardrails that wouldn't connect to each other, and lasers that pointed backward when facing east or west. The Building Materials mod also gained 40 new door types (version 1.4.3 was skipped).

sections.title: Highlights
items: Laser Gun damage buffed 8.0 → 160.0 (20x, 960 DPS), Assault Rifle damage buffed 20.0 → 200.0 (10x, 2,000 DPS)
Fixed a bug where the auto turret had actually never fired a single shot (its aiming ray started from inside its own hitbox). Also reworked target detection so it no longer targets bosses or Wardens
Fixed guardrails not connecting to each other
Fixed lasers pointing backward when facing east or west

Laser trap range 32 → 128 blocks (config cap expanded to 256). It can now be aimed in 26 directions (including diagonals and up/down) — right-click empty-handed to rotate 45° horizontally, sneak+right-click to change the angle
Added 40 new door types to the Building Materials mod (49 total, including the existing 9)

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Laser Gun: damage 8.0 → 160.0 (20x)
Assault Rifle: damage 20.0 → 200.0 (10x)

sections.title: Warnings
items: [Important] This damage buff significantly throws off the combat balance against existing bosses (you can kill them in seconds). No resistance has been added to bosses, so if this bothers you, adjust the damage values in config/sorakaze_guns.json
You need to delete config/sorakaze_guns.json for the gun damage buff to take effect
v1.4.3 was skipped and was never distributed

releases.title: Fixed a Visual Bug with Worn Angel Gear
releases.summary: Fixed a bug where actually equipping "Angel Gear" would show vanilla Netherite armor on your body and a plain Elytra on your back. It was an easy bug to miss since the inventory icons displayed correctly.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Fixed Angel Gear (armor and Angel Wings) to correctly display its dedicated silver-and-gold design when worn

releases.title: Sky Dimension Arrives, Bosses Get Signature Moves
releases.summary: Added a new dimension, "Sky," reachable through portals that rarely generate on the overworld surface. You can now trade with Angel Merchants and equip glider gear. All 10 bosses now have signature moves, and can be summoned anytime with a summoning stone. Building Materials crafting also gained selectable recipe buttons, and vehicle tires now visibly rotate.

sections.title: Highlights
items: New dimension "Sky" debuts, reachable through Glowstone portals that rarely generate on the overworld surface
Angel Merchants live in the Sky, each with a randomized selection of trades. You can obtain "Angel Wings" that let you glide, plus dedicated arrows and bows
Added a safety net for falling out of the sky (you land safely above the Overworld)
Added summoning stones for all 10 bosses, craftable so you can summon them anytime. All bosses gained a signature move (triggers below 50% HP, with a 4-second telegraph)
The 3 colossal bosses now have their power rolled randomly on spawn (30-45x the Ender Dragon's HP, then fixed thereafter)
New weapons — "Grim Reaper's Scythe," "Abyssal Trident," and "Thunder Spear" — now drop from their respective bosses
Added a toggle button to the Building Materials mod's crafting bench, letting you pick between multiple blocks from the same layout (like wooden pillar blocks)
The boss-exclusive shovel and hoe can now actually make paths and till soil
Vehicle tires now visibly rotate as you drive (10 vehicle types)

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The Sculk Golem and Rock Lock still don't have dedicated attack animations (their signature-move telegraph is particles only)
The Thunder Spear still can't be thrown (melee only)

releases.title: Boss Attack Animations & 3D Tool Models
releases.summary: Added dedicated animations for each of the 5 bosses' melee, AoE, and beam attacks. The 5 tools they drop (pickaxe, axe, hoe, spear, shovel) were also reworked from flat icons into proper 3D models. Gameplay — damage, cooldowns, and so on — is unchanged.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Added dedicated animations for each of the 5 bosses' attacks (melee, 2 kinds of AoE, and beam), making attack telegraphs (windup motions) easier to read
Reworked the 5 droppable tools into proper 3D models. GUI icons now show the 3D render too

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: Melee attacks don't have a windup like a raised-arm animation. Since vanilla melee damage triggers instantly, adding a windup would throw off the timing of when damage actually lands

releases.title: Complete Visual Overhaul for All 5 Bosses
releases.summary: In response to feedback that they "looked like palette-swaps of the same creature," we completely reworked the appearance of all 5 new bosses. Gameplay — strength, drops, attacks, and so on — is unchanged.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Runecore Colossus: a stone core with bronze/gold armor plating, 2 swords floating at its sides, and rotating rune rings encircling its arms
Emberlord: lava veins running through its body, and 2 horns that curl upward in 4 jointed segments
Elder Treant: 8 branches, each angled and broken differently (3 of them snapped partway), and a face carved into its trunk
Void Stalker: abandoned its humanoid shape for a mass of obsidian, a purple portal, 8 tentacles, and 18 glowing eyes
Frost Lich King: a 5-tiered robe, a 9-spike jagged ice crown, and a rotating ice emblem hovering above its raised left hand

releases.title: 5 New Bosses Arrive, Breaking the HP Ceiling
releases.summary: Added 5 new colossal bosses to the Boss mod. We removed the vanilla Minecraft limitation that capped HP at 1024, so these are proper bosses with 2,400-4,000 HP. Defeating one guarantees a drop of a dedicated overpowered tool (pickaxe, axe, hoe, the new weapon "Spear," or shovel).

sections.title: Highlights
items: Added 5 new bosses, summoned with craftable summoning items: Runecore Colossus (3,000 HP), Emberlord (3,400 HP), Elder Treant (4,000 HP), Void Stalker (2,400 HP), and Frost Lich King (2,800 HP)

Defeating each boss guarantees a drop of a dedicated overpowered tool: Runecore Pickaxe, Ember Axe, Treant Hoe, Void Spear (a new weapon type vanilla doesn't have), and Frost Shovel. All have high durability and come pre-enchanted with multiple enchantments, and can't be crafted

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: All 5 are designed to be tough fights, expected to be a struggle solo. If they feel too strong, admins can adjust their HP and attack power via config
Void Stalker was designed to float in the air, but is currently implemented as moving on the ground plus teleporting

groups.summary: Added 138 Building Blocks & Implemented Gun Durability

releases.title: Added 138 Building Blocks & Implemented Gun Durability
releases.summary: A follow-up based on feedback after the v1.3.2 release. Reworked the appearance of 2 bosses, and fixed the gun durability bar, which had only ever been a display up to now, to finally actually decrease. The Building Materials mod gained 138 new building blocks, and every gun's range was extended 5x.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Reworked the appearance of the Sculk Golem and Rock Lock (Sculk Golem now looks like an Iron Golem made of sculk; Rock Lock now looks like a near-future armed robot). No changes to their strength or attacks

Fixed guns' durability to finally decrease properly (previously the durability bar just displayed without actually breaking). Default durability is now roughly 1,536 shots, and Excalibur's is roughly 6,093 hits
Extended every gun's range 5x (Assault Rifle 60 → 300m, Shotgun 24 → 120m, Sniper Rifle 150 → 750m, Laser Gun 80 → 400m)
Added 138 new building blocks to the Building Materials mod (vertical slabs, octagonal-pillar columns, and 8-step slopes, across 46 different materials)

Approved a plan to gradually redesign vehicles with "rounded, realistic shapes," and finished design mockups for the sedan and propeller plane (rolling this out across all 13 vehicle types is planned for future updates)

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Extended every gun's range 5x (Assault Rifle 60 → 300m / Shotgun 24 → 120m / Sniper Rifle 150 → 750m / Laser Gun 80 → 400m)

sections.title: Warnings
items: You need to delete config/sorakaze_guns.json for the range extension to take effect

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: The "rounded design" for vehicles is currently just mockups for the sedan and propeller plane — rolling it out to all 13 types is planned for a future update

releases.title: Vehicles Enlarged & New Nether Boss "Rock Lock"
releases.summary: Scaled up cars, trains, and aircraft to be clearly bigger than the player, with more realistic proportions. Buffed the Assault Rifle and Laser Gun's damage 4x. A new boss, "Rock Lock," now appears in the Nether, and defeating it drops the powerful sword "Excalibur."

sections.title: Highlights
items: Enlarged cars, buses, trucks, motorcycles, trains, and aircraft (cars by about 1.6x, trains by 1.8x, large airliners by 2.2x, etc. — the scale varies by type)
The new boss "Rock Lock" now appears in the Nether. Summon it with a dedicated summoning item (craftable from 8 Nether Bricks + an Ender Eye), or use one that naturally spawns near Nether Fortresses
Defeating Rock Lock guarantees a drop of the sword "Excalibur" (high durability, fireproof, sets targets on fire on hit)

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Assault Rifle: damage 5.0 → 20.0 (4x)
Laser Gun: damage 2.0 → 8.0 (4x)

sections.title: Warnings
items: You need to delete config/sorakaze_guns.json for the gun damage increase to take effect
Since vehicles and trains got bigger, be careful navigating narrow roads, tunnels, and hangars

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: How often Rock Lock's summoning item naturally spawns near Nether Fortresses hasn't been confirmed (the frequency can be adjusted via config)

releases.title: Fixed the Boss Getting Killed by Wardens
releases.summary: Fixed a bug where the Sculk Golem — a precious boss limited to one per city and one per lifetime — could be killed by a retaliating Warden.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Sculk Golem no longer takes damage from Wardens, and Wardens no longer attack or hunt Sculk Golems (players can still defeat it as before)

releases.title: Boss & Vehicles Mods Debut — Now 5 Mods Total
releases.summary: Two new mods, Boss and Vehicles, joined the lineup, bringing the total to 5 mods. Now featured: a boss fight where defeating a Warden in an Ancient City spawns the boss "Sculk Golem," 13 vehicle types including cars, trucks, and planes, and new items like the Laser Gun and laser traps. The train also now supports coupling up to 15 cars into one train.

sections.title: Highlights
items: New mod "Boss" debuts: defeating 3 Wardens in an Ancient City spawns the boss "Sculk Golem" (900 HP). Defeating it guarantees a drop of the "Enhanced Beacon," which has 3x the effect range

New mod "Vehicles" debuts: adds 10 land vehicle types (cars, buses, trucks, motorcycles, and more) plus 3 aircraft types. Includes features like rotating beacons and sirens on emergency vehicles and truck beds
Added the Laser Gun (1 Energy Cell = 100 shots) and Auto Turret (only targets hostiles) to the Guns mod
Added Laser Emitters/Receivers and tables to the Building Materials mod
Improved the train coupling system to support trains of up to 15 cars, including freight and passenger cars. Also added 2 bullet-train types with a 75 m/s lead car

sections.title: Not yet implemented/confirmed at this point
items: Aircraft handling (takeoff, landing, stalling, etc.) is designed with future tuning in mind. If it feels heavy or hard to control, it can be adjusted via config

releases.title: Guns Switched to Hitscan & Fixed Doors Not Staying Still
releases.summary: Changed guns to a hitscan system where shots land the instant you fire, and added dedicated gunshot sounds. The train gained a 3D model and coupling (freight car, passenger car), and we fixed a bug where closed doors kept jittering. Hidden doors and 3 new door types make their debut too.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Changed guns to a hitscan system so shots land without waiting for a bullet to travel (hit-detection range: 60m for the Assault Rifle, 24m for the Shotgun, 150m for the Sniper Rifle)
Added new gunshot, reload, and dry-fire sounds (custom-made audio)
Enlarged guns when held, adjusted to look better in both first- and third-person
Added a 3D model to the train (commuter-train styling). You can now couple a Freight Car (27-slot storage) and Passenger Car (2 riders) to it (can't reverse while coupled)
Fixed closed doors continuously jittering
Added Hidden Doors (disguise themselves as dirt, stone, netherrack, end stone, and more)
Added 3 new door types (Roller Shutter, Sliding Door, Jail Bar Door), bringing the total to 9 door types

releases.title: Fixed Door Suffocation Bug & Major Train Speed Boost
releases.summary: Fixed a serious bug where you could take damage just from walking through a door. Raised the train's top speed to 60 m/s (config cap 80 m/s), and it now automatically preloads chunks ahead in its direction of travel while running. Also added new blocks like the elevator and conveyor belt, and unified gun controls to left-click to fire, right-click to aim, and R to reload.

sections.title: Highlights
items: [Important] Fixed a bug where you'd take damage just from passing through a door (automatic doors, fusuma, large doors, hatches). Improved so doors won't auto-close while someone is nearby
Train top speed 20 → 60 m/s (config cap can be raised up to 80 m/s). It now auto-preloads chunks ahead of travel direction while moving, reducing scenery pop-in at high speed
4 new blocks: the Elevator (jump to go up / sneak to go down), Escalator, 2 kinds of chairs, and the Conveyor Belt (moves items, stoppable with redstone)
Overhauled gun controls: left-click to fire, hold right-click to aim (scope for the sniper), R to reload
Guns now render as 3D models when held (previously they were just the same flat icon as the GUI)
The shotgun can now one-shot an unarmored enemy at point-blank range (also fixed a bug where hit invincibility frames were nullifying multiple pellets at once)

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Shotgun: pellet damage 3.0 → 5.0 (10 pellets; 50.0 total if every pellet lands at point-blank range)
Train: top speed 20 → 60 m/s, config cap 25 → 80 m/s

sections.title: Warnings
items: The meaning of the train's speed cap has changed, so after updating we recommend deleting config/sorakaze_rail.json (otherwise it'll stay at the old 20 m/s setting)

groups.label: V1.1
groups.summary: Train Behavior Improvements & Gun Buffs

releases.title: Train Behavior Improvements & Gun Buffs
releases.summary: Fixed the choppy train movement and the issue where you had to keep holding W just to keep moving. Buffed gun damage, and added a dedicated scope overlay and aim sway to the Sniper Rifle. The Building Materials mod also gained 4 new door types, including an automatic door.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Train: fixed choppy movement — it now runs smoothly
Train: pressing W once now locks in automatic acceleration and cruising with no further input needed (previously you had to hold it down). S brakes, and pressing S again after stopping reverses
Train top speed increased from 15 to 20 m/s. Reworked the train item's icon
Sniper Rifle: changed to an "aim, then release to fire" system, and added a dedicated scope overlay, ×4/×8 zoom (switch with scroll), and aim sway that's halved while sneaking
Assault Rifle: added increased spread while firing on the move

Building Materials mod: added 4 new door types — Automatic Door, Fusuma (sliding paper door), Large Door (iron/wood), and Hatch (multi-block structures that drop a single item no matter which part you break)

sections.title: Balance changes
items: Assault Rifle: damage 3.0 → 5.0, fire rate 8 → 10 rounds/sec
Shotgun: pellet damage 2.0 → 3.0 (pellet count increased to 10), effective range 12 → 16m

groups.label: V1.0
groups.summary: Initial Release: 3 Mods — Guns, Rail, and Building Materials

releases.title: Initial Release: 3 Mods — Guns, Rail, and Building Materials
releases.summary: The server got its first three mods: "sorakaze_guns" (Guns), "sorakaze_rail" (Rail), and "sorakaze_deco" (Building Materials). Vanilla bows and minecarts are untouched — you can now craft new weapons, vehicles, and city-building blocks in survival.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Guns mod: the Assault Rifle, Shotgun, and Sniper Rifle, plus their dedicated ammo (rifle rounds, shotgun shells, sniper rounds), are now craftable
Added a scope zoom feature to the Sniper Rifle
Rail mod: added a new vehicle, the "Train," that you can place on rails (vanilla minecarts, rails, bows, and crossbows are unchanged). A looping running sound plays while it's moving

Building Materials mod: added 12 kinds of blocks, including guardrails, utility poles, power lines, tactile paving (directional/warning), vehicle traffic lights, pedestrian traffic lights, aircraft warning lights, and spotlights

sections.title: Warnings
items: Making the server mod-capable requires migrating from vanilla to Fabric. Also, running Minecraft 26.2 requires Java 25 or later, so please check the Java version on the server machine (see the admin install guide for setup steps)
